items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did the Shots Madison ever play on the records with you in the old days? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Not with me. Not on the records. Shots never didn't leave Ricard.

ctx.x: That's who Ricard was the one playing second trumpet with Papa Celestine and made that Josephine. That's what it was. Ricard, he was playing. Ricard made that Ricard. That's fine. That's good.
Did the Shots Madison ever play on the records with you in the old days? Ricard. Shots. You know, Shots. Kid Schatz Madison. All you talking about Shots? Shots. Oh, sure. Was he on the records?

Not with me. Not on the records. Shots never didn't leave Ricard. Shots was stuck with Ricard. He stayed with Ricard. Shots and this boy, uh, but this boy, uh, played trombone. Well, they all stuck with Ricard. Yeah. David Jones and them, they stayed on the Pelican with Ricard. Emma Barris, all them John Porter, they all stayed with Ricard on the Pelican. Yeah.
